children.text: #692 direction (owner, 2026-08-26): candidate A — transform in place — wins. Tile geometry, 1–8 key parity and the footswitch map stay frozen; the stage takes the FX surface; each tile re-dresses with chain identity. Grafted from candidate B: the per-chain power pill (the dominant state element per tile) and the entry-run line (entries in signal order). A won on spatial stability and reading distance; B was rejected because it re-maps the performer's space mid-song and duplicates Signal's editing-scale detail one tab away. The entry-run line is where #601's dim/strikethrough idiom applies to bypassed entries (tile 3 shows the whole-chain-off dim). Meters stay truthful (pre-chain) at 40% alpha — more present than the spike's 20%. FX mode colour is PURPLE, no longer accent blue: $fx #a06be0 + $fx-surface #1e1430 (flat, per #737) + $fx-wash #a06be024. WCAG (4.5:1 floor, 14px w700): fx on fx-surface 4.74:1, fx on bg-base 5.32:1, fx on stage black 5.67:1, fx on wash-over-bg 4.60:1. High-contrast flavor (where #768/#770 slipped): fx-hc #c9a8ff on fx-surface-hc #33245a 6.83:1, on black 10.53:1. The Dart theme change — SurfaceTheme modePair FX arm → purple across all three flavors (default/neon share SurfaceTheme.dark, plus highContrast), and every FX accent use on this surface — is owed by the #692 build.

Correction (owner, 2026-08-26): the first cut of candidate A conflated the track with the FX control — it dressed track tile N with chain N's identity + power pill, falsely asserting the chain belongs to that column's track. A footswitch in FX mode toggles a BOUND CHAIN, and that chain may target ANY FX stage (input / track / lane / master) or a rack — not necessarily the track in that column. Fix: each cell is identified by the bound chain and its REAL target, written TARGET-then-chain (e.g. MASTER · REVERB, LANE 2 · DRIVE, INPUT · GATE, TRACK 3 · CRUSH). ALWAYS chain-first: even when a chain genuinely targets the column's own track, show it as "TRACK n · <chain>" and never borrow the track's name/number as the cell identity, so the performer never learns the false tile=track-FX model. The track name is gone from the cell; the footswitch number (1–4) stays as a small physical-switch position marker, so spatial continuity — candidate A's one good property — is preserved. Sample cells now mix stages (MASTER · REVERB [ON], LANE 2 · DRIVE [OFF], INPUT · GATE [ON], NO CHAIN) so it's obvious chains aren't track-bound. Unchanged: purple FX treatment ($fx #a06be0 / $fx-surface #1e1430 / $fx-wash #a06be024, HC $fx #c9a8ff on #33245a), the ON/OFF power pill, the entry-run signal-order chips, meters at 40% alpha, and the NO-CHAIN state.
